column1: # Browser-behavior acceptance oracle for every product panel in docked and detached windows.

# status: PASS = the pinned HTML/Blitz path is sufficient and present; ADAPTER = Motolii must map browser behavior to product meaning; N_A = the operation has no product meaning (reason is mandatory).

# implementation: CLOSED_TEST = exercised by a focused test; CLOSED_STATIC = present in the current source path; PARTIAL = only part of the acceptance exists; REQUIRED = no complete implementation is present; NONE_BY_DESIGN = deliberately absent.

# ADAPTER is a responsibility classification, not a completion claim; only CLOSED_TEST or CLOSED_STATIC is closed. For an N_A row, REQUIRED means the key/event still needs a scope guard so it cannot leak into another panel's meaning.
# HTML and Pointer Events define the browser/platform baseline; APG defines authored composite-widget keyboard and accessibility behavior; PRODUCT defines the editor-specific commit and Undo meaning.
# reconciled: 2026-09-05; implementations share panel_body across docked/detached roots; CLOSED_TEST may name one representative shared-path regression.
